name: Sharp India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1985, Sharp India Ltd is engaged in manufacture and sale of liquid crystal display televisions (LED TVs) and Air Conditioners.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is a wholly owned Indian subsidiary of Sharp Corporation, Japan which holds 75% of issued share capital of company. Also, company has a technical collaboration with Sharp for the manufacture of ‘LED TVs’ and ‘ACs’.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
